column1: # One line per mod folder. Columns (tab separated):
#   side:   server = host only, client = runs on your own game, both = has a host part and a local part
#   client: yes = goes in the client build,
#           no = server build only, later = client build once its stock-script edits are ported to wraps
#   files:  what it touches. prx:<file> = a script in thugpro_qb.prx (server build) / dadmod_qb.prx (client build),
#           dll:<inc> = included in binkw32.dll, data:<path> = a file in the game's data folder, dadmod:<file> = <game>\dadmod\
